description: This file declares functions and includes necessary headers for managing low latency utilities, specifically for handling parameter names, getting and setting values from a database, and publishing latency measurement events in a software project.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Returns the parameter name associated with a given path string.

methods.name: getLatencyParamName
methods.description: Maps a low latency parameter enum to its string name.

methods.name: LowLatency_CastValueFromString
methods.description: Converts a string value to a typed value based on the specified rbus value type.

methods.name: LowLatency_GetValueFromDb
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from the database based on its name and type.

methods.name: LowLatency_SetValueToDb
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in the database with a specified name.

methods.name: LatencyMeasure_PublishToEvent
methods.description: Publishes a latency measurement event with a specified name and data.
